title: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
script:
Meta just created a brand new stock class to fund its massive AI push.
Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg revealed the non-voting stock in the third-quarter earnings report.
The funds will also go toward potential corporate acquisitions and staff compensation.
Trading for this new stock class is officially scheduled to begin in twenty twenty-seven.
The enormous scale of investment is required to compete and expand AI infrastructure.
Would you buy non-voting shares to fund AI development?
